tagline: Leading global manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices
hero_kpi_rationale: The record backlog of $3.58 billion reflects sustained structural demand in niche industrial markets, amplified by strategic acquisitions and organic growth, making it a key indicator of future trajectory.
company_description: AMETEK, Inc. manufactures and sells electronic instruments (EIG) and electromechanical (EMG) devices in the United States and internationally. It operates through EIG and EMG segments. The company offers advanced instruments for the process, aerospace, power, and industrial markets; process and analytical instruments for the oil and gas, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, automation, and food and beverage industries; instruments to the laboratory equipment, ultra-precision manufacturing, medical, and test and measurement markets; power quality monitoring and metering devices, uninterruptible power supplies, programmable power and electromagnetic compatibility test equipment, and gas turbines sensors; dashboard instruments for heavy trucks and other vehicles; instrumentation and controls for food and beverage industries; and aircraft and engine sensors, embedded computing, monitoring, power supplies, fuel and fluid measurement, and data acquisition systems for aerospace and defense industry. It also provides engineered medical components and devices, automation solutions, thermal management systems, specialty metals, and electrical interconnects; single-use and consumable

kpis.signal: Historical high, leading indicator of future revenue

kpis.name: Orders

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue amounted to $7.40 billion in 2025, up 6.6%, supported by acquisitions and organic growth.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 25.8% in 2025, up 20 basis points, due to operational efficiency gains.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.summary: Fluctuations in interest rates and foreign currencies can affect the company's financial condition and results. The company implements strategies to mitigate these risks.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 7A, the language is factual without strong intensity. The risk is managed through normal operations and geographic diversification, but fluctuations may impact financial results. The score is moderate as hypothetical analysis suggests losses are not material. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Integration of Acquired Businesses
risks.summary: The integration of recent acquisitions (Kern, FARO) was not included in the assessment of internal controls, representing a potential risk to consolidation and financial reporting reliability.
risks.score_rationale: Noted in the internal control report, the exclusion of Kern and FARO (8.4% of assets) from the internal control assessment is a point of attention. The language is neutral but the potential impact on integration and controls is significant. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Valuation of Intangible Assets
risks.summary: The valuation of intangible assets, particularly brands and trademarks, is complex and depends on key assumptions sensitive to future market conditions, presenting a risk of valuation error.
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a 'Critical Audit Matter' by the auditor (Ernst Young LLP), highlighting complexity and subjectivity of judgment. Intangible asset valuation relies on sensitive assumptions (discount rates, revenue forecasts) subject to economic uncertainty. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Effectiveness of Internal Control
risks.summary: The internal control system, while effective, has inherent limitations. The exclusion of recent acquisitions from the main assessment raises questions about full risk coverage.
risks.score_rationale: Although internal control was deemed effective, the report notes inherent limitations and the exclusion of recent acquisitions. The auditor also conducted a specific audit on this matter. The risk is moderate as the overall opinion is positive, but limitations are acknowledged. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Non-Disclosure of Forward-Looking Information
risks.summary: The company is not obligated to update forward-looking statements unless required by law, which could limit visibility into future developments.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the introduction, the company's commitment not to publicly update forward-looking statements except when legally required. The language is factual. The risk is minor as it is a standard clause, but it highlights potential opacity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impact of Tariffs and Trade Restrictions
risks.summary: Additional tariffs and trade restrictions were announced in 2025. While not material for 2025, the company acknowledges future uncertainty regarding impacts on demand, costs, and inflation.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in MD&A Item 7 as a recent trend. The U.S. government announced additional tariffs and trade restrictions in 2025. Although the impact was not material in 2025, the language indicates future uncertainty. The score is moderate due to the company's ability to adapt its global supply chains. (default score, to be refined)

evidence: AMETEK has consistently added to its investment in research, development and engineering, and improved its new product development efforts with the adoption of Design for Six Sigma and Value Analysis/Value Engineering methodologies along with artificial intelligence tools.
